name: Consulting Assistant
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: shortdescription: A site that acts as an assistant to consulting engineers. It is capable of comparing shop drawings to spec sheets and looking through your Everything database for the files you need

This app is designed to help engineering consultants handle the tedious day to day tasks that take up so much time. There are two functionalities of this app, the first is a shop drawing comparison and the second is an Everything search function. The shop drawing comparison function relies on two agents, the receptionist agent and the expert agent. The receptionist agent acts as a screen for the documents that are sent in.
